description.value: Lazzez's Grill is a fully licensed fine-dining Indian restaurant on Barnet Highway in Coquitlam, with a focus on tandoor cooking — clay-oven tikkas, seekh kebabs, and freshly baked naan are menu centrepieces. Chef Gurdeep Singh brings experience from India, the UK, and Canada, and the kitchen produces a broad menu spanning meat, seafood, vegetable, and gluten-free options. The restaurant has outdoor seating, accepts walk-ins, and offers takeout and catering, making it a viable sit-down or grab-and-go stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and confirms the OSM address (2786 Barnet Hwy, Coquitlam, BC) and provides a phone number (+1(604) 941 3411) absent from OSM. The Services section explicitly lists 'Take Out,' and the menu includes items labelled vegan and gluten free. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Phone number was absent from OSM; sourced from website (+1(604) 941-3411 per front page and contact page). The about.html subpage shows a garbled number '+1 104 024 720' — likely a data-entry error on that page.
Website copyright reads '© 2015 lazzez's grill', suggesting the site has not been updated in many years; current operating status should be verified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active full-service restaurant with outdoor seating, takeout, and a broad menu including vegan and GF options — a useful food stop for touring cyclists on Barnet Highway. Bike-specific amenities are unconfirmed and should be verified on-site.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu labels several items as vegan (e.g. Vegetable Samosa, Vegetable Pakora, Onion Bhaji) and many items as gluten free (e.g. Vegetable Pakora, most Tandoori Sizzler dishes, numerous chicken and lamb items)
